status: Declared before fetching or inspecting historical success-rate observations or current rankings
purpose: A separate current-season scrimmage-consistency ranking; no changes to SOR or predictive strength

metric.definition: CFBD stored successful plays: at least 50% of needed yards on first down, 70% on second, 100% on third/fourth; scoring-play exceptions follow its documented classification
metric.denominator: Provider-covered PPA-eligible plays; excludeGarbageTime=false; no claim of all box-score plays or regulation-only coverage
metric.scope: Scrimmage consistency, not a complete special-teams/turnover/scoring-opportunity grade

sources.retention: Raw inputs encrypted to a locally held recipient key for transfer; decrypted caches remain ignored/private. Only derived research and source/code fingerprints are public.
sources.outcomes: Existing repaired historical season contexts; current exact saved published snapshot. Full parent schedule fixes weekly cutoff even when a statistic is missing.
sources.identity: Exact game ID then reciprocal canonical names. Explicit aliases may only come from the current CFBD snapshot via the same stable team ID; no fuzzy matching or invented membership.
sources.validation: Require positive integer plays, overall rate in [0,1], near-integral rate*plays within 1e-5 and mirrored opponent defense; reject invalid pairs and report them against the full eligible denominator.
sources.currentReplay: Current snapshot has no recoverable kickoff/week fields; compute a current illustration only, not a 2026 pregame replay. Newer outside-snapshot games excluded.
sources.excludedYears: 2020 pandemic/spring coverage differs; 2021-2022 are not needed for this declared first train/selection/evaluation split.

model.observation: One paired net success-rate observation and weight per game, rather than two independent observations or weights proportional to tempo
model.equation: netRate = individualEffectA - individualEffectB + homeRate*venue + divisionRate*divisionSign + residual
model.divisionSign: +1 for FBS against FCS, -1 reversed, zero within subdivision
model.fit: Ridge penalty on individual current-season effects. All measured FCS opponents remain individual. Total team rating = individual effect plus divisionRate/2 for FBS or minus divisionRate/2 for FCS.
model.calibration: For each ridge/family, fit the exact affine venue/division response by older FBS-involving future-week least squares, with no coefficient sign restriction.
families: matched shrunken raw-rate control with learned venue/subdivision
model.matchedRawControl: Same paired games, same unit-game weighting and ridge grid; own signed adjusted-net sums divided by games+ridge, with subdivision offset, but without opponent effects. Fit venue/division via the same older-only affine procedure.
model.output: All FBS teams with measured games; idle unranked, fewer than four provisional. Display in percentage points above the current measured FBS mean, preserving total-score ordering.
model.explanations: Exact normal-equation per-game additive reconciliation plus model/context offset. Never imply raw offensive/defensive diagnostics are separate adjusted unit ratings.

selection.criterion: Pooled per-game net-rate mean squared error across FBS-FBS and FBS-FCS games; ties select smaller ridge
selection.cutoff: Exclude target and all same-week statistics; only previously processed full-parent-schedule weeks with kickoff at least 24h before earliest target-week kickoff
selection.noTeamHistory: Every season starts neutral; only global learned coefficients carry forward
selection.currentOrder: Compute/inspect 2026 ranking only after older-only selection; it cannot select settings

groups: established FBS-FBS (both at least four measured prior games)
sensitivity: exclude cross-subdivision games on current order
engineeringReadinessChecks: At least 98% paired FBS-game coverage in each historical evaluation year and complete paired coverage of the saved current FBS snapshot
Exact per-team score reconciliation and finite stable solutions
Selected adjusted model improves pooled held-later FBS efficiency MSE over the matched raw control; report paired block interval without claiming independent games
Report all subgroup/year regressions; no silent claim of uniform superiority or complete football performance
Absolute pooled FBS-oriented cross-subdivision bias at most 0.02 net-rate units (two percentage points) and smaller than the zero-subdivision control
No automatic replacement of SOR/predictive strength; expose limitations and source scope if any Performance view is later published
evaluation.interpretation: These are declared engineering/research checks, not proof of one objectively correct order or genuinely prospective superiority. Corrected retrospective source availability and PPA-based coverage remain limitations.
